Items.useTooltip: Gamble ammo or durability, roll on the table, then enter your score in chat to apply the damage multiplier.
Items.useTooltipWeapon: Spend ammo or durability to set your damage multiplier, then roll and apply the result in chat.
Items.rollMultiplierHint: Multiply score by this number to produce the final score. Set to 0 to disable the multiplier.
Items.rollMaxHint: Cap on the multiplied score. A natural dice total (rolled without the multiplier) may still exceed this cap. Set to 0 to disable the cap.
Items.damageBaseHint: Multiplier applied to your roll result when using this weapon (e.g. 2 = 2×). The first ammo or durability spent uses this value only.
Items.damageAdditionalHint: Extra multiplier per ammo or durability spent beyond the first (e.g. 0.4 with base 2 gives 2× for 1 spent, 2.4× for 2, 2.8× for 3).
Items.attachedSkillHint: When set, using this weapon rolls (attribute + skill) d6 on the virtual dice table.
Items.durabilityEnabledHint: When enabled, this item tracks durability and can gamble durability on rolls.
Items.brokenTooltip: {name} is broken (0 durability) — restore it before using.
Items.reloadEnabledHint: When enabled, this weapon can be reloaded from a consumable on the character sheet.
Items.restoreEnabledHint: When enabled, durability can be restored from a consumable on the character sheet.
Items.restoreRequiredNamesHint: Comma separated list of allowed consumable names. When set, only matching items can be selected as a restore source.
Items.restoreTooltipUnconfigured: Set maximum durability on this weapon to enable restoring.
Items.selectRestoreTooltip: Click to pick a consumable as the restore source.

Items.editRestoreTooltip: Double-click to edit restore source item.
Items.ammoCurrentHint: Loaded ammo gambled on each use. Refilled via Reload when reload is enabled.
Items.ammoMaxHint: Maximum ammo this weapon can hold. Reload refills up to this value.
Items.requiredAmmoHint: Comma separated list of allowed ammo names. When set, only matching consumables can be selected as a reload source.
Items.reloadTooltipUnconfigured: Set Ammo Capacity on this weapon to enable reloading.
